reply.text: {"say":"No bench pressing here: a machine press and a dip lead, then cable and pec deck flies finish the chest, with a push-up to close.","title":"Chest Day (No Bench)","days":[{"name":"Chest Day","exercises":[{"key":"machine-chest-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze the handles together at the top"},{"key":"parallel-bar-dip","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lean forward slightly to load the chest"},{"key":"machine-incline-chest-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Control the lowering phase"},{"key":"cable-crossover","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Slight elbow bend, hug the arc"},{"key":"pec-deck-fly","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause when the handles meet"},{"key":"low-to-high-cable-fly","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Sweep up toward chin height"}]}],"unmet":[]}
